summary: Official Village Global pages describe Velocity as an active rolling program for pre-seed founders, with capital, network access, compute perks, and global participation. No fixed cohort dates or deadlines are published.

proposed_event.name: Village Global Velocity
proposed_event.description: Rolling pre-seed program with capital, peer cohort, network access, and AI compute perks for founders worldwide.

dates.date_range_text: Applications are accepted on a rolling basis; founders can join from anywhere in the world.

sources.title: Village Global Velocity
sources.supports: Official page states Velocity is a bespoke pre-seed founder program, applications are accepted on a rolling basis, Village invests up to $1M, founders can join from anywhere, and AI founders receive Microsoft, OpenAI, and Anthropic perks.

sources.title: Village Global Velocity Application
sources.supports: Official application page confirms founders can apply to be considered for Village Global's Velocity program for early-stage founders.

notes: No current fixed application deadline, cohort start/end date, timezone, venue, or demo day was published on the official pages.
The source context said terms are variable; the official page currently states Village invests up to $1M on the Velocity page and $500k-$3M in pre-seed and seed rounds in the FAQ.
